title: Collection Handling Added to a Service Charge where an Account Has Gone Quiet, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
An account that has run a long way past due with no money coming in carries a flat collection handling sum on top of the service charge worked out on it.

**Clause.** Where the overdue days run past 60 and no payment has been posted to the account over the 3 statement months before the handling date, the collection handling sum is 75.00 USD. Where the overdue days run past 30 but not past 60 and no payment has been posted to the account over those three months, the collection handling sum is 35.00 USD. In every other case no collection handling sum is added on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Overdue days | Payments posted over the 3 statement months | Collection handling sum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| more than 60 | none | 75.00 USD |
| more than 30, up to and including 60 | none | 35.00 USD |
| 30 or fewer | none | No sum is added |
| any | one or more | No sum is added |

Both bands are read strictly past their day: 60 overdue days sits in the lower band and 61 in the upper, while 30 overdue days carries no sum and 31 carries the lower one. A single payment posted inside the three statement months takes the account out of the clause whatever the overdue days.
